text: Doran Design 是面向网页与产品界面任务的 DSH 设计技能包，通过注册技能和系统提示规则提供设计指导。它以 shadcn/ui 处理结构、Canvas UI 处理特效、ThreeUI 处理 3D，并给出组件选型、视觉比例、性能预算和交付验收清单。技能强调可读性、Radix UI Colors、克制动效及移动端降级，适合制作 Landing Page、Dashboard、作品集和创意界面。按 README 安装到 DSH profile；代码未显示需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

Doran Design is a DSH design skill for web and product UI. It registers a skill and prompt rules for shadcn/ui structure, Canvas UI effects, and ThreeUI 3D. It guides component choice, performance, fallbacks, and review for landing pages, dashboards, and portfolios.
想让 AI 按一套清晰的网页设计规范做 Landing Page。
帮我规划 Dashboard 的组件、颜色和页面层级，避免视觉规则互相打架。
Help me design a product page with restrained effects and a practical mobile fallback.
Doran Design 的功能「网页设计技能」：提供网页设计手册，涵盖 shadcn/ui、Canvas UI、ThreeUI 的分层、组件选型、性能预算与验收清单；agent 可按任务调用，用户也可显式调用。
Doran Design 的功能「常驻界面规则」：插件注册 doran-design-rules 系统提示段，让网页和 UI 任务持续遵循三层设计原则、GPU 特效限制、Radix 颜色、文字可读性、克制动画及移动端降级要求。

doran-design README · Doran Design：A DSH skill pack for web and product UI design. It registers one agent skill and one short system-prompt section that makes the three-layer design rules apply to every web task.

doran-design README · What it adds：- Skill `doran-design`: a full playbook covering
  - shadcn/ui as the structure layer
  - Canvas UI as the effect layer
  - ThreeUI / three.js as the 3D layer
  - the 80 / 15 / 5 visual-area split
  - component selection, performance budgets, fallbacks and an acceptance checklist
- System-prompt section `doran-design-rules`: a compact hard-rule set that always applies, including the one-GPU-effect-per-viewport rule, Radix UI Colors, 0.5px borders, the 12px minimum text size and the mobile/reduced-motion fallback requirement.
doran-design README · What it adds：The plugin does not write `AGENTS.md`. The hard rules are contributed through `ctx.systemPrompt.section`, so installing the plugin is enough.

doran-design README · Install：Install the prebuilt tarball from GitHub Releases:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Doran1110/doran-design/releases/download/v0.1.1/doran-design-0.1.1.tgz
```

Then add the package to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list if your DSH version does not reconcile bundles automatically:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["doran-design"]

Restart the profile after installing.

doran-design README · Use：Ask the agent for a landing page, dashboard, portfolio or any Canvas/WebGL/Three.js interface. The skill is model-invocable under the name `doran-design`; you can also invoke it explicitly with `/skill doran-design` where the client supports skill invocation.

doran-design README · Notes：- The plugin registers the same skill name as the local `doran-design` skill. Runtime skills rank 250, so the installed plugin takes precedence when both exist; keep only one to avoid duplicate catalogs.
- Runtime skills are registered at rank 250. If another provider exposes the same name, the nearest layer wins.
- The package ships no browser UI; `dsh.client` is intentionally absent.
- Requires DSH 0.1.0-rc.1 or newer.
